title: He Already Wrote the Ending
the_thought: He thinks AI will do the work, and people should get paid anyway.
hook: In 2021, Sam Altman wrote that thinking software would do more and more of the work people now do.

levels.name: The Short
beats: He said the price of labor would fall toward zero. Then he said people should still get paid, from a fund filled by taxing companies and land. A year later his chatbot was writing the emails. Offices pasted their jobs into the box and waited. He thinks AI will do the work, and people should get paid anyway.
